name: Colin Coccolin
source:
Colin is a shopkeeper working in an Item Shop in the town of Ice from the Free Cities Alliance. She's an extremely dedicated and firm believer of the Haniwa Temple. 

She's extremely loyal and passional to her beliefs, wearing lots of Hanny items and even her clothing has hanny stapled in it. She also has Hanny figures in her eyes. She's polite and friendly, albeit often trying to convince others while talking about her faith.

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Corin_Coccolin]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
